prompt: A cinematic, high-angle wide shot of two women wearing elaborate traditional Chinese Hanfu dresses walking through a vast, dimly lit palace hall. The scene is filled with atmospheric haze and soft, warm candlelight reflections on the polished dark stone floor. The woman on the left wears a flowing gown in shades of deep red and cream with long trailing sleeves, her hair styled in an intricate updo with gold ornaments. The woman on the right wears a similar style dress in lighter peach and beige tones, also with ornate hair accessories. In the background, tall pillars and hanging lanterns fade into the misty distance, creating a sense of depth and mystery. The lighting is moody and ethereal, highlighting the texture of the silk fabrics and the reflective surface of the floor.

promptZh: 电影感高角度广角镜头，两名身着华丽中国传统汉服的女子正穿行于一座宏大而光线昏暗的宫殿大殿之中。画面中弥漫着朦胧的雾气，柔和温暖的烛光倒映在深色抛光石质地面上。左侧女子身穿深红与米白相间的飘逸长裙，长袖拖地，秀发挽成精致的发髻，点缀着金色头饰。右侧女子的裙装款式相近，色调为更浅的桃粉与米色，同样佩戴着华美的发饰。背景中，高耸的立柱与悬挂的灯笼渐渐隐入迷蒙的远方，营造出深邃而神秘的空间感。整体光影氛围浓郁、空灵缥缈，细腻勾勒出丝绸面料的质感与地面的如镜倒影。
